title: ACT.TR.------EXPN.
description: Second diagram on page 472 (TRF(II)-8), paired with EXPN x PROG-CONT above. The crossing diagrams how actual-transformation structurally meets expansionism at the political-and-social-dynamics scale: ACT-TR (actual transformation) crossed with EXPN (expansionism). ACT-TR sits at lower-center with the subject-arrow; EXPN at upper-center as partner-axis. WO-UNF (world unification) upper-left, SPT-GH (spiritual growth) upper-center, TRS (transition) upper-right. PROG-CONT (progressional continuance) right. SOC-PR (social programs), PHY-U-C (physical-universe context), SOC-RT-DEV (social-reality development), RT-ALGN (reality alignment) on the left chain. STF (source transfer) center, C-INFO (composite information) right, T-C-IMP (time continuum implications), SG (source-generation) lower-right. Structural argument: act.tr crossed with expn produces transformation via the upper chain SPT-GH/TRS, with progressional-continuance as partner output; the lower-left chain produces social-reality alignment, the right chain feeds composite-information and time-continuum-implications.
